description: Fiori — Colore: Burnt apricot & silvery gold Codice: 5611 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Floral Scala: Small Altezza: 139 cm Rapporto: 11 cm × 11.5 cm Toni: Orange Like a sweet-smelling trellis full of blossoms, FIORI, an 18th-century Persian design, provides an alluring backdrop for a moment of repose. The Sufi poet Rumi wrote that Beauty surrounds us, but usually we need to be walking in a garden to know it. FIORI’s eternal blooms are a perpetual reminder to appreciate all that is good and awesome around us.
